<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Kindle Inner Flames](/Feats.aspx?ID=4244) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Stance" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=152" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 29

</column>

---

As a candle can light another, you awaken the latent potential to channel fire in other creatures. You shed faint, glowing embers, as do your allies while they're in your kinetic aura. Anyone shedding these embers gains a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves and [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks and can Step as a free action once per round. When an affected creature takes a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=114) action, its Strikes deal an extra 2 fire damage until the end of its turn.

---
**Level (12th)** The status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks is +2, and the Strikes gain the [_flaming_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=295) rune instead of the extra 2 fire damage.
name: Kindle Inner Flames
